scenario: Fresh cache hit within the same context
description: Cached enrichment data is retrieved for the same user and tenant context, with valid freshness metadata.
safe_action: Accept the cached result because it is fresh, context-isolated and supported by audit evidence.

description: No cached enrichment data is available, so the workflow uses a safe fallback path without leaking data.
safe_action: Proceed through the safe fallback path because no cache record is available and context isolation is preserved.

description: Cached enrichment data exists but is outside the expected freshness window and should not be trusted automatically.
safe_action: Review the workflow and refresh the enrichment data because the cache entry is stale.

scenario: Shared cache key without user isolation
description: Cached enrichment data is scoped only to the tenant and may expose data across users within the same tenant.
safe_action: Block the cached result because the cache key is not isolated to the user context and may leak data.

scenario: Global cache key used for context-specific data
description: Context-specific enrichment data is stored under a global cache key, creating a cross-context leakage risk.
safe_action: Block the workflow because context-specific data must never be served from a global cache key.

scenario: Fresh cache entry without audit evidence
description: Cached enrichment data appears fresh but has no audit evidence proving where it came from or when it was generated.
safe_action: Review the cached result because freshness cannot be trusted without audit evidence.

scenario: Expired cache entry with safe refresh path
description: Cached enrichment data has expired, but the workflow can safely refresh the data without serving the stale record.
safe_action: Use the safe refresh path because the cache entry is expired and should not be served directly.

scenario: Disabled cache with safe direct lookup
description: The cache is intentionally disabled and the workflow uses a direct lookup path while preserving context isolation.
safe_action: Accept the workflow because the cache is disabled intentionally and the direct lookup path preserves isolation.
